Below the text, a printed watermark URL at the bottom right, not transcribed.; One page of a table in three columns of entries, read from top to bottom: the first printed line at the top right, then the columns of numbers and names running down the page; the cut-off left part holds the first columns. main_text.p: Dionysius cuius meminerunt Ptolemæus 400 annos ante Ptolemæum Euergetem, qui fuit ... Ptolemæus 400 annos ante Ptolemæum Euergetem, quem Dionysius Bonassarem 486.
Eratosthenes natus olympiade 126 Athenis, Alexandriam accersitus est sub Ptolemæo Euergete, præfectus bibliothecæ Alexandrinæ, cuius usque ad Ptolemæum Epiphanem præfuit, mortuus est 80 anno ætatis.
Hipparchus Rhodius post Alexandrum annis 196 Ante Ptolemæum 266 annis.
Sosigenes, cuius opera Iulius Cæsar annum ad solis cursum accommodavit.

page.notes: The right column of dates (Claruit circa a mundi 3842, 3903, 3615) and the right edge are cut off; the readings here are partial. Some words at the line ends on the right are cut and are not transcribed. The left-hand columns are cut off, so several lines are fragmentary. Lines reading "runt", "nnū" and "stum" are partial words. The numerals are printed in a decorative face and some may be misread. The line at the top reads "Hipparchus, &" with the ampersand in a decorative form, and the second line is partly cut at the left.
